Reels.title: Plan a 30-second lesson.
Reels.subtitle: Pick a shape, write the angle. Reachy drafts the scenes — you edit the lines, we render in 9:16. Reels here teach an insight; they don't pitch.
Reels.fieldIdeaPlaceholder: What's the single insight this lesson lands? (e.g. why most product feedback is noise, and the one signal worth chasing)
Reels.composingSora: Sora is rendering each scene — usually 2–5 minutes per scene.
Reels.noVideoUrl: No video URL yet — check the worker logs.
Reels.sceneImageUrlHint: Generate the image in the Image tab first, then paste its public URL here.
Reels.errorMissingImages: All image-backed scenes need a URL before composing.
Reels.errorPlan: Could not plan the reel. Try again.
Reels.errorCompose: Could not start composition. Try again.
Reels.errorPoll: Status check failed. Reload to retry.
Reels.errorNoOpenAI: OpenAI is not configured. Set OPENAI_API_KEY to plan reels.
Reels.errorNoFal: fal.ai is not configured. Set FAL_KEY to use Veo 3.1.
Reels.errorNoR2: R2 storage is not configured — reels can't be uploaded.
Reels.noBrandKitNote: No identity set yet. The CTA scene falls back to ink+paper colors.
Reels.modeAiBody: You give an angle; Reachy writes the lines and image prompts.
Reels.modeScriptBody: You write the exact lines. Reachy only generates the visuals around them.
Reels.scriptLengthError: Your script has {got} lines but this shape needs {need}.
Reels.scriptEmpty: All scene lines must have text.

informative-25s.label: Explainer · 25s — Hook / Insight / Insight / Takeaway
informative-25s.description: Calm teaching pace. One insight per scene, a quiet takeaway at the end. The default when in doubt.

tutorial-30s.label: How-to · 30s — Intro / Step / Step / Step / Result
tutorial-30s.description: Walk a reader through five beats. Numbered captions, single thread of progression, the result at the end.

feature-15s.label: Feature note · 15s — Hook / Feature / Benefit / CTA
feature-15s.description: A close-up on one feature. Hook, show, prove, invite. Brief and scannable.

pitch-30s.label: Argument · 30s — Friction / Change / Outcome / Intent
pitch-30s.description: Five beats: name the friction, sit with it, offer the change, show what shifts, end with intent. The most direct shape — use sparingly.

launch-20s.label: Release note · 20s — Announcement / Detail / Why
launch-20s.description: A quiet announcement of a new release. What changed, why it matters, where to look.

visual-12s.label: Mood · 16s — Four frames
visual-12s.description: Four ambient frames with slow motion. Imagery leads, captions whisper. Best for brand pieces, not for a single message.

testimonial-20s.label: Quote · 20s — Setup / Quote / Quote / Brand
testimonial-20s.description: A short story told through a customer's words. Setup, two quotes, your wordmark. Lets the reader speak.

ffmpeg.label: FFmpeg composition
ffmpeg.tagline: Stitches your generated images with text overlays. Cheap and fast.

veo.label: Veo 3.1 Fast
veo.tagline: Generates the entire reel from one prompt. Slower (~3 min), more impactful.

Identity.title: Set the look, voice, and stance.
Identity.visualStyleHint: How reels and images should look. No real people in any style — graphics, type, and motion only.
Identity.styleEditorialTagline: Big serif type, thin rules, paper-and-ink. Matches the Reachy landing 1:1.
Identity.stylePaperCutoutTagline: Layered cut-paper shapes with hard shadows. Headway / Fable feel.
Identity.styleFlat2dTagline: Bold geometric characters, thick outlines. Duolingo / Mailchimp.
Identity.styleInfographicTagline: Numbers counting up, bars growing, lines drawing. Data leads.
Identity.styleIsometricTagline: Floating 3D blocks, tiny figures, pastel gradients. Notion / Linear.
Identity.styleAbstractTagline: Soft color blobs morphing. Premium and ambient. Apple / Stripe.
Identity.voiceDontSayPlaceholder: Banned words or phrases — one per line.
Identity.audiencePlaceholder: Latin American indie hackers shipping their first SaaS, technical but not obsessed with code…
